resources.string: Parental Content Control & Family Safety Tool
Device Protection is active. The app cannot be removed until you deactivate Device Protection in Settings > Security > Device Administrators.
Activating Device Protection prevents PBLOCK from being removed. This ensures family safety content filtering stays active.

To remove PBLOCK:
1. Open Settings
2. Go to Security > Device Administrators
3. Deactivate PBLOCK
4. Uninstall the app

PBLOCK is a parental content control tool that helps families maintain a safe online environment. It blocks access to adult content by modifying system DNS settings.

Features:
• Blocks 200+ adult websites
• Forces SafeSearch on Google and Bing
• Works on rooted and non-rooted devices
• Password-protected settings
• Survives device reboot

This app is designed for responsible adults who want to protect themselves or their children from inappropriate online content.

PBLOCK is designed as a self-accountability and parental control tool. It is intended for responsible adults who wish to maintain a safe online environment for themselves or their families. The app modifies system DNS settings to block access to adult content. Use responsibly.
